# Test LangGraph Deployment

> **📍 Testing standards centralized**
>
> For deployment fixture patterns and usage, see `docs/dev/testing/test-fixtures.md`.

## Quick Start

This directory contains a minimal LangGraph echo application for integration testing.

**Deployment:** See `DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md` for step-by-step deployment instructions.

**Environment Variables:**
```bash
export LANGSMITH_API_KEY="<your-api-key>"
export LANGSMITH_WORKSPACE_ID="<your-workspace-id>"
export TEST_GRAPH_ID="<graph-id-from-deployment>"
```

**Full testing documentation:** `docs/dev/testing/test-fixtures.md`
